facts.function: optical detection assembly (excitation and fluorescence detection) of a capillary electrophoresis genetic analyzer

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 instruments for physical or chemical analysis; parts and accessories at 9027.90
Section XVI/Chapter 90 note 2(b): parts solely or principally for a particular instrument go with that instrument
GRI 6: 9027.90.56 parts of electrical instruments of 9027.20/.30/.50/.81/.89; .95 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts are not simply lenses or optical elements; the assembly is a part of an analyzer (chapter 90 note 2(b))
requires the analyzer to be in 9027.50.40; the exact analyzer subheading is not established
G83746 put an oven assembly of a genetic analyzer there, but this is an optical assembly, not a heating device

missing_facts: Which subheading the analyzer itself is in (e.g., 9027.50.40 optical or 9027.89), which would change the .56 suffix
classification.rationale: The optical assemblies are parts of an analytical instrument of heading 9027, placed in 9027.90 parts and accessories of electrical instruments. G83746 (in force) concerns a different assembly of a genetic analyzer, so it is only context, not a precedent on this part. Suffix is the residual line.
